properties.description: Daily schedule trigger, 02:00 South Africa Standard Time — after overnight settlement files land (~01:15) and before the 07:00 executive review. COST CONTROL: ships with runtimeState 'Stopped' and a hard endTime of 2026-10-03. On a Fabric trial capacity a scheduled pipeline fires every night for the full 60 days whether anyone is watching or not, and each run burns capacity units across a Copy activity, four notebooks and a semantic model refresh — shipping this enabled is how a demo workspace quietly consumes a trial. Enable only when scheduled refreshes are actually wanted, and disable again as soon as the demonstration is over. The endTime sits one week before the trial expires (activated 2026-08-11 + 60 days = 2026-10-10) so the trigger cannot outlive the trial or roll into a paid capacity unnoticed. Timezone is named explicitly rather than computed from UTC: SAST is UTC+2 with no daylight saving today, but if the capacity region ever moves, an implicit offset would silently shift the run by an hour.
